lines.text: God promises to rebuild Virgin Israel, and watchmen on Ephraim's hills will cry, "Arise, let us go up to Zion."
God will bring them from the north and lead them beside streams of waters on a level path.
The One who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them as a shepherd keeps his army.
Rachel weeps in Bethlehem for her children, but the LORD says they will return from the land of the enemy.
When God restores them, Judah will speak a blessing, and He will refresh the weary soul.
